goal: Lock Bora's Mass General Brigham employer-family exclusion and a preferred discovery-source verification ladder for fresh Career OS operation.
acceptance_conditions: Mass General Brigham system roles are Bora-specific employer-family exclusions and do not enter serious Bora-facing discovery or package generation unless Bora explicitly overrides or revokes the exclusion
the exclusion includes first-party roles identified as part of the Mass General Brigham system even when the employing legal entity or affiliate name differs
the exclusion is a pursuit preference and never rewrites historical Submitted Application Truth, Employer Truth, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, or Qualification Truth
LinkedIn Free and Brandeis Handshake are preferred first-wave discovery surfaces, alongside targeted employer/official ATS searches, for efficient high-signal inventory discovery
specialized credible boards and staffing/recruiting sources remain valid secondary discovery channels
generic aggregators and search/index results remain lead-generation sources only and receive lower discovery confidence
discovery-source preference never upgrades a platform listing into Employer Truth or current actionability

serious-role promotion still requires the existing authoritative recency gate, start-horizon gate, the §138.6.2 employer-family-exclusion check PASS, exact first-party semantic actionability quorum, and package-time recheck
LinkedIn or Handshake posting age alone cannot satisfy the authoritative recency-anchor requirement
resume package qualification immigration and runtime doctrine remain unchanged
stop_conditions: implementation requires schema or src runtime changes
implementation weakens first-party semantic actionability or recency verification
implementation treats LinkedIn or Handshake as final Employer Truth authority
implementation globally blacklists Workday or any non-MGB employer family
implementation alters resume or cover-letter gold doctrine
